title: 前端 UI/UX 评审
scope: Evidence-based review of rendered web interfaces: task flow, visual hierarchy, responsive layout, keyboard behavior and accessibility.
routingDescription: Review a web screen, form or component for usability, visual hierarchy, responsive layout, keyboard or accessibility issues.
useWhen: A screenshot, prototype or live web flow needs interface review
An implemented control needs a keyboard, contrast or responsive check

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use product requirements to define scope or acceptance before a concrete interface exists.
Use user research to design studies or interpret participant evidence.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Trace the user goal through the primary action, feedback, and recovery after failure.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Prioritize task blockers over visual preferences.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When interactive controls or overlays are involved
diagnosticChecklist.check: Verify keyboard operation and visible focus. For a modal, check initial focus, focus containment, Escape and focus return.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Report observed failures by state and give a keyboard retest.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When reviewing text, controls or a narrow viewport
diagnosticChecklist.check: Measure contrast, check target size and test reflow against applicable WCAG 2.2 criteria and exceptions.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Separate measured failures from checks still requiring a live page.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When reviewing screenshots or a rendered page
diagnosticChecklist.check: Identify the primary action and whether headings, labels and states guide the intended task.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Recommend a concrete change tied to the task and supplied design system.

evidenceRequirements: User goal, page or component, and affected state
Use a rendered page or recorded checks for claims about focus, dimensions, contrast or reflow
qualityChecks: Give each finding a location, user impact, proposed change and reproducible acceptance check
Separate observed behavior, inference and untested states
riskRules: A screenshot or automated scan alone cannot establish accessibility conformance

refreshTriggers: A current standard or component behavior is in dispute
knowledgePolicy.onMissing: State what must be verified on the live interface.

examples.input: A screenshot of a send-confirmation dialog shows faint text. Is the dialog accessible?
examples.expected: Flag possible contrast issues. Request rendered colors and a keyboard trace before claiming contrast or focus failures.
examples.reject: Declare WCAG conformance or say focus management was tested from a screenshot.

adaptations: Use the pinned usability source for task-based evidence discipline. WCAG 2.2 and WAI-ARIA APG are separate references for the authored accessibility checks.
